files.inner.sh:
mode=$1
arg=${2-}

fi
/usr/bin/mount -n --bind "$PWD/snap" /proc || exit 92
if [[ $mode == repeat ]]; then
 top --once > "$HOME/a.out" 2> "$HOME/a.err"; a=$?
 top --once > "$HOME/b.out" 2> "$HOME/b.err"; b=$?
 if [[ $a == 0 && $b == 0 ]] && /usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/a.out" "$HOME/b.out" && /usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/a.err" "$HOME/b.err"; then printf 'repeat=PASS\n'; else printf 'repeat=FAIL\n'; fi
elif [[ $mode == fds ]]; then
 shopt -s nullglob
 before=("$HOME/realproc/$BASHPID/fd/"*)
 top --once > "$HOME/top.raw" 2> "$HOME/top.err"; a=$?
 after=("$HOME/realproc/$BASHPID/fd/"*)
 if [[ ${#before[@]} -ge 3 && $a == 0 && ${before[*]} == "${after[*]}" ]]; then printf 'success-fds=PASS\n'; else printf 'success-fds=FAIL\n'; fi
 before=("$HOME/realproc/$BASHPID/fd/"*)
 top --once > /dev/full 2> "$HOME/full.err"; b=$?
 after=("$HOME/realproc/$BASHPID/fd/"*)
 if [[ ${#before[@]} -ge 3 && $b == 1 && ${before[*]} == "${after[*]}" ]]; then printf 'failure-fds=PASS\n'; else printf 'failure-fds=FAIL\n'; fi
 printf 'success_status=%d failure_status=%d\n' "$a" "$b" > "$HOME/fd-status"
elif [[ $mode == full ]]; then
 top --once > /dev/full 2> "$HOME/top.err"; result=$?
 /usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terra-local-terminal-top-observer.py full "$result"
else
 if [[ $mode == header ]]; then top "$arg" > "$HOME/top.raw" 2> "$HOME/top.err"; result=$?
 elif [[ $mode == memory ]]; then top --once -o mem > "$HOME/top.raw" 2> "$HOME/top.err"; result=$?
 elif [[ $mode == cap ]]; then top --once -n 2 > "$HOME/top.raw" 2> "$HOME/top.err"; result=$?
 else top --once > "$HOME/top.raw" 2> "$HOME/top.err"; result=$?; fi
 /usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terra-local-terminal-top-observer.py "$mode" "$result"
fi

cases.purpose: The disposable VM /dev/full sink returns ENOSPC; top reports write failure.
cases.setup_script:
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c '
/usr/bin/mount -n --bind "$PWD/snap" /proc || exit 91
[[ $(< /proc/loadavg) == "0.25 0.50 1.00 1/3 303" ]] || exit 92
[[ $(/usr/bin/getconf PAGESIZE) == 4096 ]] || exit 93
' 
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os,errno; f=os.open("/dev/full",os.O_WRONLY);
try: os.write(f,b"x"); raise SystemExit(99)
except OSError as e: assert e.errno==errno.ENOSPC
finally: os.close(f)'
